library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(units)
library(AOI)


eqdc <- "+proj=eqdc +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-96 +lat_1=20 +lat_2=60 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs"


conus_states <- aoi_get(state = "conus") %>% st_transform(eqdc)
north_america <- aoi_get(country = c("USA", "CA", "MX")) %>% st_transform(eqdc)


us_cities <- read_csv("data/uscities.csv")

Rows: 31254 Columns: 17
── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","

ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.

us_cities_sf <- st_as_sf(us_cities, coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>% 
  st_transform(eqdc)


cities_with_states <- st_join(us_cities_sf, conus_states)
cities_conus_eqdc <- cities_with_states %>% filter(!is.na(state_name.x))  

state_borders <- conus_states %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")


country_borders <- north_america %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")


mexico_border <- north_america %>%
  filter(admin == "Mexico") %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")


canada_border <- north_america %>%
  filter(admin == "Canada") %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")


cities_conus_eqdc <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  mutate(
    dist_to_national_border = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, country_borders)),
    dist_to_state_border    = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, state_borders)),
    dist_to_mexico          = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, mexico_border)),
    dist_to_canada          = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, canada_border))
  )


us_outline <- conus_states %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING")  


cities_conus_eqdc <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  mutate(dist_to_us_border = as.numeric(st_distance(geometry, us_outline)))


library(flextable)

top5_far_from_border <- cities_conus_eqdc %>%
  arrange(desc(dist_to_us_border)) %>%
  select(city = state_name.x, state = state_name.x, distance_m = dist_to_us_border) %>%  
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(distance_km = round(distance_m / 1000, 1)) %>%  
  select(city, state, distance_km)


flextable(top5_far_from_border)
